risks.risk: Edition/printing mismatch (e.g., not the exact Seventh Edition or not the Oxford/Shorter Oxford version).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the copyright/edition page inside the book (title page or verso) showing “Seventh Edition” and publication year.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the pictured book but treat as potentially not the exact edition until the inside edition page is confirmed.

risks.risk: Condition issues (missing pages, heavy highlighting, water damage, torn cover/spine).
risks.proof: Ask for photos of: (1) spine, (2) back cover, (3) inside pages near the beginning and middle, and (4) a close-up of any damage/marks.
risks.if_unproven: Price at a worst-case used condition (possible markings/wear) rather than like-new.

risks.risk: Completeness (supplementary materials not included, if any).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the inside front cover and any included inserts/attachments (if present).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the inside title/copyright page showing the exact edition (Seventh Edition) and publication details.
Photos of spine and back cover.
Photos of 2–3 interior page spreads (beginning, middle) to confirm completeness and condition (no missing pages/water damage).
response.reason: The book identity is readable from the cover, but the photos don’t show condition or confirm the exact edition/printing from inside pages—both strongly affect the Lagos used-book price.
